text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the location and severity of your flank pain, and confirm if you have any difficulty or pain when urinating?

text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of kidney stones or prior urinary tract infections, and are you experiencing any nausea or vomiting along with your fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or a foul odor? Also, does the pain radiate toward your groin or lower abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.
